facts.text: Sudbury was founded in 1883 after nickel ore was discovered during Canadian Pacific Railway construction, evolving from a mining town into a vibrant urban center.
The interactive science museum focuses on geology and mining history and is home to the Big Nickel, one of Sudbury's most famous landmarks.
SNOLAB, originally built for the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory, now operates as a leading underground particle physics laboratory.
The city hosts the Up Here Festival, blending underground music with public murals, and the francophone La Nuit sur l'étang music event.
In 1970 a tornado struck Sudbury, one of Canada’s worst, causing significant damage and loss of life.
